name: Industrial outdoor storage (IOS)
summary: IOS sites are low-coverage (<10–20%) yards for trucks, trailers, containers and equipment: the cost is almost entirely sitework — grading, stabilized aggregate or paved surface, stormwater, perimeter security fencing, lighting — plus a small office/shop. The surface spec (gravel vs. asphalt vs. concrete) swings cost 2–3×. No authoritative per-acre IOS benchmark was found; the default is a bottom-up derivation from the paving building block, checked against one low-confidence developer blog.

typicalSize.method: Typical IOS parcels 2–15 usable acres (judgment from listing norms); mid 5 acres.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Building SF (office/shop) per acre of yard: ~1,000–5,000 SF building on a 2–15 acre site (judgment).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Bottom-up per acre (≈ 4,840 SY; ~85% surfaced = 4,100 SY): clearing/grading/subgrade $8k–$20k; surface = stabilized 8" aggregate at paving-block gravel-road $9–$25/SY (MDT crushed aggregate, e10) → $37k–$103k (mid $62k), or asphalt at $45/SY → $185k; stormwater/detention $15k–$40k; perimeter fence ~400 LF/acre (5-acre site) × $35–$70 → $14k–$28k; lighting ~2 poles/acre → $12k–$20k; office/shop and utilities $75k–$250k per site ÷ 5 acres → $15k–$50k. Mid (gravel yard with paved entry/office area) ≈ 14 + 62 + 25 + 20 + 16 + 30 ≈ $167k → $175k; low (all gravel, trailer office) ≈ $100k; high (fully paved asphalt/heavy concrete) ≈ $350k–$410k → $375k. Plausibility: blog IOS development $150k–$300k for an unstated (small) site (e2).

perSF.method: Per SF of SITE (not building) = per-acre ÷ 43,560.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P: clearing, grading, stabilized/paved surface, stormwater and detention, perimeter fence and gates, site lighting, CCTV, small office/shop with on-site utilities. Excludes land, environmental remediation, off-site utilities/road work, soft costs and fees.

qualityTiers.method: economy = low/mid (gravel, minimal office); premium ≈ asphalt-paved yard (~$260k/acre ÷ mid); luxury = high/mid (heavy-duty concrete, maintenance shop).

systemSplit.method: From the bottom-up mid: surface + fence ≈ $82k (32), grading/subgrade incl. aggregate base prep ≈ $35k (31), stormwater $17k (33), lighting/power $13k (26), cameras/gates $5k (28), modular office $7k (13), GC 8%. Judgment.

lineItems.name: Stabilized aggregate yard surface (8" crushed aggregate)

cost.method: From _blocks/paving.json gravel-road ($9/$15/$25 per SY, 2025; MDT crushed aggregate). Quantity ≈ 85% of an acre = 4,100 SY.

lineItems.name: Asphalt paving upgrade over aggregate (incremental)

cost.method: Paving-block asphalt $30/$45/$70 per SY less the aggregate base already in the baseline (~$10–$25/SY) ≈ $20–$45/SY incremental.

lineItems.notes: Optional upgrade for tenants storing trailers/equipment on paved surfaces.

lineItems.name: Perimeter security fence with barbed/razor wire and gates

cost.method: No public unit price fetched; 8 ft chain-link with security wire incl. posts/footings and gate allowance $35–$70/LF (judgment). ~400 LF per acre for a ~5-acre rectangular site.
Judgment: 25–35 ft pole with LED heads, base, conduit and wiring $6k–$10k each; ~2 per acre.

lineItems.name: Small office/shop building (~1,500–3,000 SF PEMB or modular)

cost.method: From _blocks/vertical-building.json building-steel-preengineered ($70/$105/$160 per SF). 2,000 SF per project (judgment).

lineItems.notes: Carve-out; set to a modular trailer for economy sites.

pctOfHard.method: Civil design, survey, geotech, stormwater/environmental permits: the blog lists environmental assessment $5k–$20k, soil testing $2k–$10k and environmental permitting $5k–$50k per project (same source as e1); for a ~$900k (5-acre) project these plus civil design ≈ 8–18% (judgment).

softCosts.notes: Zoning/conditional-use permits are often the gating item for IOS; excludes financing.

hard.method: Unknown soils/fill and stormwater requirements dominate risk on former industrial land (judgment).

perPrimaryUnit.method: min ≈ gravel yard with trailer office (hard low $100k less 10%, minimal soft); max ≈ fully paved concrete yard (high $375k × 1.3).

source.title: Cost to Develop an Industrial Outdoor Storage Site

evidence.quote: Site preparation lump sums: clearing and excavation $10,000–$50,000; surfacing for internal roads and pads $50,000–$200,000; drainage systems $20,000–$100,000 — "typical U.S. construction cost ranges as of 2025."
evidence.scopeNotes: Developer blog (RecNation Storage, 10 Dec 2025); project size (acres) not stated, so cannot be converted to per-acre directly. Low confidence.

source.title: Cost to Develop an Industrial Outdoor Storage Site

evidence.quote: Project totals table: IOS development $150,000–$300,000 vs. indoor $1,000,000–$2,500,000; stormwater management system $50,000–$200,000 (one-time)
evidence.scopeNotes: Same blog; acreage unstated (implicitly a small 1–3 acre site). Used only as a plausibility check.

openQuestions: No authoritative IOS improvement-cost benchmark found; broker research (e.g., Cushman/Newmark IOS reports) or a public site-plan cost estimate would replace the derivation.
Fence and lighting unit costs are derived; a fencing/lighting bid tab would help.
